replacement.name: JW Marriott Hotel Pune
replacement.tagline: 414-room Marriott flagship on Senapati Bapat Road — 8 dining venues including Alto Vino, rooftop temperature-controlled pool, and the easiest cross-city positioning between Koregaon Park nightlife and Hinjawadi business.

replacement.name: Hyatt Regency Pune
replacement.tagline: Large-format Hyatt on Weikfield IT Park 25 minutes from Pune airport — reliable Hyatt service and full conference facilities at roughly 25% less than JW Marriott. The Pune last-night-before-flight bed.
replacement.address: Weikfield IT Park, Nagar Road, Pune 411014, Maharashtra

replacement.name: Conrad Pune
replacement.tagline: Hilton's Conrad on Mangaldas Road — closer to Aga Khan Palace and Shaniwar Wada than the IT-park hotels. Coriander Kitchen breakfast spread runs the widest in town; rooftop pool faces the old-city skyline.

replacement.name: Marriott Suites Pune
replacement.tagline: All-suite Marriott in Koregaon Park — Pune's cafes-and-nightlife neighbourhood — suites larger than standard 5-star rooms, pet-friendly, 10 minutes' walk to German Bakery and Osho Garden.
replacement.address: 81 Mundhwa Road, Koregaon Park Annexe, Pune 411036, Maharashtra
